where: Sunkbell Shallows (the flooded-shrine spur off Fen II, reached by Tidecall)
mood: The fen relit — open water, a drowned shrine bell ringing under the ripples, a warmer lilting waltz you've earned.
core_styles: D major with a wistful minor turn
clear warm pulse-wave and flute lead in a lilting melody
ringing bell-buoy chime arpeggios of broken major chords
deep bell tolling softly beneath the water
rocking compound synth bass with gentle propulsion
soft kick on the downbeat and a light offbeat shaker
dewy, ringing, hopeful open-water discovery, a drowned shrine

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a deep sunken bell tolls once beneath the water, ripples of rising chime arpeggios bloom out of it, and the lead calls a bright rising phrase that lands on a held chord}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the lilting melody in full: a hopeful rising leap that settles home warmly, chime arpeggios rippling underneath, the bass rocking forward like a boat on open water}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the melody again with a second bell voice in harmony a third above and a soft string pad, the sunken bell striking on the first beat of every fourth bar}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a wistful turn to B minor over the drowned shrine roof, long breathy flute notes on sustained strings, drums drop to shaker only, then a rising chime run lifts back to D major}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the lilting melody returns, bright and confident; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
